description:
DevService that starts a Grafana LGTM container (grafana/otel-lgtm: an OpenTelemetry collector
        with Grafana, Tempo, Loki and Prometheus) for vidocq:dev and the tests, when MicroProfile Telemetry (Humboldt)
        is on the application's class path, and publishes otel.exporter.otlp.endpoint. Runs in the Maven plugin JVM
        only.
